programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u009/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cross_row = next(r for r in range(h) if all(v == 3 for v in grid[r]))
    cross_col = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(h)))
    out = []
    for r in range(h):
        row = []
        for c in range(w):
            if r == cross_row or c == cross_col:
                row.append(3)
            else:
                dr, dc = abs(r - cross_row), abs(c - cross_col)
                row.append(4 if ((dc <= dr and dr % 2 == 0) or (dc > dr and dc % 2 == 0)) else 0)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(program_path),'exec'), globals())
